title: Observing block
description: An observing block, as read by numina from each document of a YAML file

id.description: Identifier of the observing block, unique in the session

pipeline.description: Pipeline of the DRP, 'default' if not defined

children.description: Identifiers of the observing blocks whose results are used by this one

parent.description: Identifier of the parent observing block, computed from the children of the parent

enabled.description: If false, the observing block is not reduced unless enabled in the command line

requirements.description: Values of the requirements of the recipe, by name

labels.description: Values of the tags, that override those of the images
